snippet.title: Little Mage - Official World Premiere Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
A world premiere reveal of Little Mage, a beautifully handcrafted, architecturally inspired, and narratively rich Metroidvania from a brand-new solo developer. FGS Live From gamescom latam debuted the game’s first trailer, showing off set-pieces, complex allies, memorable bosses and deep customisation options - from awesome gear to complex skill trees. Little Mage contains its own fully playable mini-game, Darc, with thousands of cards to collect. It’s coming to PC and all major consoles. Wishlist now and follow the upcoming Kickstarter.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
